direction_definitions.forward: fraction of current observation surface representatives within tolerance of prior track surface
direction_definitions.reverse: fraction of prior track surface representatives within tolerance of current observation surface

surface_support.missing_evidence: candidate run fails preflight; never silently omit an observation
surface_support.multiple_candidates: choose unique best only when score margin meets locked threshold; otherwise defer

rationale.support_tolerance: two 0.02 m voxels to allow small discretization/depth noise without broad proximity matching
rationale.minimum_support: 100 supported representatives prevents a small contact patch from passing alone
rationale.partial_view: forward support permits an observation to cover a subset of an accumulated surface; reverse support is diagnostic and guards the larger-observation containment case
rationale.reference_inspiration: ConceptGraphs compute_overlap_matrix_2set uses nearest-point support from map objects to new detections with an asymmetric denominator; this adaptation adds symmetric diagnostics and causal prior-state gating
